fields.label: Full name (as in passport)
fields.hint: Enter your full name exactly as printed in your passport's bio-data page. Avoid symbols or punctuation.
fields.warning: Spelling must match your passport exactly. Discrepancies will lead to rejection at boarding/entry.

fields.label: Sex / Gender
fields.hint: Select your gender matching the passport value.

fields.label: Date of birth
fields.hint: Enter your date of birth in DD/MM/YYYY format.
fields.warning: Make sure year, month, and day are entered in correct fields.

fields.label: Current nationality
fields.hint: Select your current nationality as in your passport.

fields.label: Religion
fields.hint: Enter your religion. You must enter a value; if none, write 'None' or 'No'.
fields.warning: Do not leave this field blank. Write 'None' if you do not want to specify.

fields.label: Email Address
fields.hint: Enter an email address you have access to. The registration code and approval letter will be sent here.
fields.warning: Verify spelling carefully. If you enter an incorrect email, you will not receive your visa code.

fields.label: Passport Number
fields.hint: Enter your passport number exactly as shown on the details page, including letters and numbers.
fields.warning: Do not confuse the number '0' with letter 'O'.

fields.label: Passport Type
fields.hint: Select the type of passport you hold. Most tourists travel on an 'Ordinary' passport.

fields.label: Date of issue
fields.hint: Enter the date your passport was issued (DD/MM/YYYY).

fields.label: Date of expiry
fields.hint: Enter the expiration date of your passport (DD/MM/YYYY).
fields.warning: Your passport must have at least 6 months of validity remaining from the date of arrival in Vietnam.

fields.label: Issuing authority
fields.hint: Enter the authority that issued your passport (e.g., 'IPS', 'GOVERNMENT OF INDIA', 'MINISTRY OF EXTERNAL AFFAIRS').

fields.label: Purpose of entry
fields.hint: Select the reason for your visit. For tourism, select 'Tourism'.

fields.label: Intended duration of stay (days)
fields.hint: Enter the number of days you intend to stay, up to 90 days.
fields.warning: Your visa will be issued matching this duration. Overstaying will lead to fines or deportations.

fields.label: Intended date of entry
fields.hint: Enter the date you plan to enter Vietnam (DD/MM/YYYY).
fields.warning: You cannot enter Vietnam before the date approved on your e-visa. You can enter on or after that date.

fields.label: Allowed to entry through checkpoint
fields.hint: Select the specific airport, land border, or seaport through which you will enter Vietnam.
fields.example: Noi Bai Int Airport (Hanoi) or Tan Son Nhat Int Airport (Ho Chi Minh City)
fields.warning: You MUST enter through the exact checkpoint selected on your e-visa. You will be denied boarding/entry if you attempt to enter through a different checkpoint.

fields.label: Allowed to exit through checkpoint
fields.hint: Select the checkpoint through which you will leave Vietnam.

fields.label: Intended temporary residential address in Vietnam
fields.hint: Enter the name and complete physical address of your first hotel or accommodation.
fields.example: Hanoi Golden Lake Hotel, B7 Giang Vo, Ba Dinh, Hanoi
fields.warning: Do not write just the hotel name. You must write the full street address, ward, and district.

fields.label: City / Province of temporary address
fields.hint: Select the province or city corresponding to your hotel from the dropdown list.
fields.warning: This city/province selection must match the address entered in the field above.
